title: docs: record Z-Image Vast replacement
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Replaces retired Z-Image instance `45313816` with production instance `46598648`.
- Records the two-replica burn of `$0.742222/hr` and measured savings of `$22.40` per 30-day month.
- Documents restart, deterministic image, sustained-load, production-traffic, and post-destruction health evidence.
- Notes the Estonia host's non-disruptive DNS refresh warnings for future monitoring.

Validation:
- `git diff --check`
- 135-image canary load test: 0 errors, 3.75s p95
- 14 attributed production requests: 10 successful, 4 expected 422, 0 server 5xx
- 4 tunnel connections and 5/5 shared-hostname health probes after target destruction
